nodes.label: Division fixture rows overlap status badges at 390px
nodes.rationale: Rated high severity despite low visual polish elsewhere because this is the exact fixture list an organiser uses on-site during a live match — the core matchday workflow.

nodes.label: Division tab bar overflows with no scroll affordance
nodes.rationale: Likely the same shared tab-row component used by settings pages, so one component fix covers both surfaces.

nodes.label: Tie-break cascade legend leaks English rule names
nodes.rationale: Rule names are joined from a raw array instead of routed through the ui message catalog; column abbreviations (P/W/L/GF/GA/GD/PTS) may be intentionally universal.

nodes.label: Division card title truncates with ample space and no tooltip
nodes.rationale: max-width sized for a worst-case many-card layout rather than the actual card width; no title attribute means the full name is unrecoverable.

nodes.label: Cricket T20 rounds displayed out of chronological order
nodes.rationale: Either the auto-scheduler assigned kickoff times without respecting round sequence, or the list sorts by internal round_number instead of earliest kickoff_at; must be determined whether seed data or the real code path produces it.

nodes.label: Registrations panel H1 and breadcrumb stay English
nodes.rationale: Page appears to have been missed from the translation pass that covered the rest of the division/settings shell.

nodes.label: FAB overlaps the primary Save settings button
nodes.rationale: Evidence the FAB bug is not merely cosmetic — it can sit on top of primary form-submit buttons and cause a missed or partial tap.

nodes.label: Group-stage generate reports success while creating zero fixtures
nodes.rationale: A skipped-precondition path reuses the generic 'matches are up to date' message, so the copy actively misleads an organiser into thinking nothing is left to do.

nodes.label: Public registration link input illegible on mobile
nodes.rationale: Low severity because Copy/Open/QR still function; the organiser just cannot visually verify the link.
